note: The event ledger is ground truth and independent of every telling; it is never shown on screen as such.

events.what: R. brings the borrowed silver box, with the ring in its slot, back to the listener's aunt.
The aunt opens the box and sees the ring. R. closes the lid; as he turns, the box passes behind his body and he palms the ring with his far hand. The aunt receives the closed box.

events.when: 14 March 1953, the same day, after the visit
events.what: R. pawns « une bague or, un brillant » for 9 000 F; a receipt is issued to the depositor « A. R. ».
The aunt passes the box to the listener; the ring slot is empty.

claims.speaker: R.
claims.text: « Votre boîte… je l'ai rapportée chez votre tante le 14 mars, en main propre. »
claims.desired_effect: credibility: establish himself as the honest returner; draw her closer

claims.speaker: R.
claims.text: « Elle l'a ouverte devant moi. » / « La bague y était. »
claims.asserted_event: EV2 (first half: the aunt opened it and saw the ring)
claims.desired_effect: move any doubt onto the aunt and onto the time after his visit

claims.speaker: R.
claims.text: « Je l'ai refermée, je la lui ai donnée. » … « Rien n'y manquait. »
claims.desired_effect: closure: end the question and be cleared

wants_now: to be cleared of the missing ring

teller.resistance: the box on her lap; the receipt in his pocket

wants_now: to decide whether to trust him
listener.tactic: listen without reacting; check the object, not his face
listener.decision: ends the encounter: receipt into the slot, lid closed, turns away
